action: No action needed; for awareness. YPFB says the incident will be audited and the final report will determine next steps under the law.
date_note: Date YPFB confirmed the breach in a communique (Monday), per the news report; the article does not give the date of the breach, which it places on a Saturday at 14:00.
exec: A breach at Bolivia's state fuel company stopped billing and fuel sales at its service stations, according to a Bolivian news report.
geo_basis: country as stated; city of the affected stations not stated
plain: Bolivia's state oil company says its computer systems were breached. Billing stopped at its petrol stations, so fuel sales stopped. The article says service was restored.
summary: A Bolivian news report says YPFB said its computer systems were breached on a Saturday at 14:00, suspending billing and fuel sales at its service stations. In a Monday communique YPFB said it activated security protocols and secured institutional information. The article says service was restored, YPFB will audit the incident, and it gives no cause or culprit.
title: Bolivia's state fuel company YPFB confirms computer breach that halted fuel sales at its stations

validation.note: Single publisher (a Bolivian outlet) quoting YPFB's communique; a web search surfaced no second publisher.
